photos.name: crumb-shot-quarter-cut
photos.summary: Whole loaf on wire rack alongside a quarter-cut piece on a cutting board showing the crumb. Crumb is even with moderate hole structure — tighter than recent bakes. Banneton ring pattern visible on the whole loaf's crust.

photos.name: finished-boule-on-rack
photos.summary: Finished sourdough boule cooling on a wire rack. Golden-brown blistered crust with banneton ring pattern from no-linen proofing. Single score line opened with good spring. Olive oil bottle and grinders in background.
